1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
     2	# debt-check.sh — 欠账红线检查（复盘建议 1，docs/project/discussions/2026-08-29-process-retrospective.md）
     3	#
     4	# 作用：把两类隐性欠账变成 CI 可失败的硬指标：
     5	#   1. TODO(dep) 占位（并行开发期遗留，承诺回填但从未立项）
     6	#   2. 面向用户的 "not yet implemented" 桩（运行时返回 IsError）
     7	#
     8	# 规则：相对基线（scripts/debt-baseline.txt）只允许下降，不允许上升。
     9	# 下降时提示更新基线；上升时直接失败并指出新增位置。
    10	#
    11	# 用法：
    12	#   scripts/debt-check.sh           # 检查（CI / make debt-check 调用）
    13	#   scripts/debt-check.sh --update  # 欠账减少后刷新基线（随同一次 PR 提交）
    14	set -euo pipefail
    15	
    16	cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."
    17	
    18	BASELINE_FILE="scripts/debt-baseline.txt"
    19	COUNT_CMD='grep -rn "TODO(dep)" --include="*.go" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | grep -v "/vendor/" | wc -l | tr -d " "'
    20	STUB_CMD='grep -rn "not yet implemented" --include="*.go" ./internal ./pkg ./cmd 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | wc -l | tr -d " "'
    21	
    22	if [[ "${1:-}" == "--update" ]]; then
    23	  count=$(eval "$COUNT_CMD")
    24	  stubs=$(eval "$STUB_CMD")
    25	  printf 'TODO_DEP_BASELINE=%s\nNOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE=%s\n' "$count" "$stubs" > "$BASELINE_FILE"
    26	  echo "基线已更新: TODO(dep)=$count, not-yet-implemented=$stubs → $BASELINE_FILE"
    27	  exit 0
    28	fi
    29	
    30	if [[ ! -f "$BASELINE_FILE" ]]; then
    31	  echo "错误: 找不到 ${BASELINE_FILE}（应随仓库提交）。请先运行 scripts/debt-check.sh --update 生成。"
    32	  exit 1
    33	fi
    34	
    35	source "$BASELINE_FILE"
    36	
    37	count=$(eval "$COUNT_CMD")
    38	stubs=$(eval "$STUB_CMD")
    39	
    40	fail=0
    41	
    42	if (( count > TODO_DEP_BASELINE )); then
    43	  echo "❌ TODO(dep) 数量上升: $count > 基线 $TODO_DEP_BASELINE"
    44	  echo "   新增的占位不会被任何机制跟踪回填（复盘 P6）。"
    45	  echo "   如确需新增，请在 PR 说明中给出回填 issue 编号，并同步更新 scripts/debt-baseline.txt。"
    46	  fail=1
    47	elif (( count < TODO_DEP_BASELINE )); then
    48	  echo "✅ TODO(dep) ${count}（基线 ${TODO_DEP_BASELINE}，减少了 $((TODO_DEP_BASELINE - count)) 个）"
    49	  echo "   提示: 请运行 scripts/debt-check.sh --update 刷新基线后一并提交。"
    50	fi
    51	
    52	if (( stubs > NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE )); then
    53	  echo "❌ 用户可见 not-yet-implemented 桩数量上升: $stubs > 基线 $NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE"
    54	  echo "   新增位置:"
    55	  grep -rn "not yet implemented" --include="*.go" ./internal ./pkg ./cmd 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | cut -d: -f1 | sort -u | head -20
    56	  fail=1
    57	elif (( stubs < NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE )); then
    58	  echo "✅ not-yet-implemented 桩 ${stubs}（基线 ${NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE}，减少了 $((NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BASELINE - stubs)) 个）"
    59	  echo "   提示: 请运行 scripts/debt-check.sh --update 刷新基线后一并提交。"
    60	fi
    61	
    62	if (( fail )); then
    63	  exit 1
    64	fi
    65	echo "欠账红线检查通过。"
